site: Example Unity UR3 pick-and-place planning bench (unity-technologies__robotics-object-pose-estimation); not a deployment approval
notes: Example operator overlay. It fills the operator_required bounds of the planning command so the fake can be exercised; each range is one bench's choice, not a Unity or Universal Robots specification. The UR3 URDF of the clone states -3.14159265359 to 3.14159265359 rad for each arm joint (ROS/src/ur3_moveit/URDF/ur3_with_gripper.urdf:361), which this example states in degrees.

start_joints_deg[*].reason: example: the clone's URDF joint limits of +-pi rad, stated in degrees
